a=np.array([[int(x) for x in l.split()] for l in rows.splitlines()]); seen=set(); comps=[]
for r in range(15):
 for c in range(7):
  if a[r,c]==7 and (r,c) not in seen:
   stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cc=[]
   while stack:
    x,y=stack.pop(); cc.append((x,y))
    for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
     q=(x+dx,y+dy)
     if 0<=q[0]<15 and 0<=q[1]<7 and a[q]==7 and q not in seen: seen.add(q);stack.append(q)
   comps.append(cc)
[(len(c),min(x for x,y in c),max(x for x,y in c),min(y for x,y in c),max(y for x,y in c), sorted(c)) for c in comps]
